Krownlandia Airtime Puzzle

Arrange three imaginary segments so the schedule fits every clue. Take your time. You can solve each puzzle aloud, on paper, or using the optional controls.

The historical inventory names Krownlandia airtime puzzle shop, credited to @tytomiwa (page 11). These radio puzzles are new prototype interpretations. There is no live broadcast, shop, or reward.

Morning mix

Segments: Weather, Song, Interview.

  • The interview is last.
  • The song follows the weather.
Set the running order

Read the solution

Weather → Song → Interview. Once the interview is last, the weather must go first for the song to follow it.

Evening mix

Segments: Story, News, Instrumental.

  • The news is neither first nor last.
  • The instrumental is before the story.
Set the running order

Read the solution

Instrumental → News → Story. The news must be in the middle, so the instrumental goes first and the story last.
